authority.appendices: Original lanes are evidence and design antecedents, not competing command/schema specifications.

public_cli.existing_semantics: Retain scripts/campaign run and submit existing campaign/simulation semantics and readout analysis/reuse semantics. New analysis namespace must not invoke the simulation launcher; existing readout functions are reusable.

worker_transport.rule: Existing Dockerfile.analysis ENTRYPOINT python3 supplies interpreter; literal argv, not shell or Ref:: expansion. Worker is an internal transport for this same contract, not another public campaign entrypoint.

scope.root_discovery: Stage 0 bounded authorized bucket-root delimiter/known-root discovery; campaign/ is not assumed the only results root; restricted/inaccessible roots explicitly blocked. Add discovered unregistered/new prefixes; exclude derived root.

proposed_storage.publication_rule: only expose catalog snapshot after immutable partition hashes, counts, errors, and checkpoints validated; COMMIT create-if-absent last

budget_rules.admission: Machine admission/reservation against an already approved scientific scope and budget envelope; a current matching quote and finite ceilings are required, not a fresh PI approval per operation.
budget_rules.shared_limits: disjoint shard reservations summing within parent; retries/resumes/query jobs charge same ledger; reserve before request; no reset on resume
budget_rules.stop: before operation exceeding any remaining ceiling; checkpoint and BUDGET_STOPPED nonzero; no successful completeness claim
budget_rules.pricing: timestamped source, region, compute basis, S3 requests/storage, ECR/logs, artifact/egress, KMS if used; unknown price blocks quote; Spot scenarios not guarantee
budget_rules.pilot: stratify every schema/archive family, hull including mega, largest central-directory/member classes, scan_rows, source/derived joins, corrupted/archived cases; bootstrap cap approved before measurement
budget_rules.quote: observed operations and p50/p95/max bytes/decode/time; cold count extrapolation labeled dated, then frozen inventory quote; worst-case concurrency/retries/storage bounds; archive restoration excluded and blocked

automatic_reservation.rule: Automatically reserve remaining budget for each in-envelope query, page, resume, phase or campaign; bind admission_id, scope_hash, quote_id and expiry to the parent envelope and retain ledger/receipt. Phase-specific reservations are machine records, not new manual tokens.
automatic_reservation.fail_closed: Expired/absent envelope, unmatched scope/quote, insufficient remaining budget or inaccessible credentials => blocked nonzero; no implicit authority.

source_read_rules.version_pin: nonempty VersionId other than literal null; else IfMatch ETag on every HEAD-reconciled GET/range
source_read_rules.changed: 412 or identity mismatch => SOURCE_CHANGED; stop/quarantine affected shard, no mixing; revised source snapshot new attempt
source_read_rules.range: validate status/ContentRange/returned bytes and account retries; reject whole-body response to range beyond budget
source_read_rules.hash: ETag treated as opaque identity, not content hash; SHA256 compressed bytes actually read and logical decompressed summary/member, derived partition files; do not download full originals just to hash
source_read_rules.zip: EOCD validated including comment, ZIP64 locator/records and nested member paths; stored/deflate supported explicitly; CRC and size/decode bounds; duplicate/ambiguous members quarantined; unsupported encryption/compression declared; no unsafe extraction
source_read_rules.archives: per-run and fused multi-run ZIPs separate identities (object,member path), scan JSONL, standalone JSON/gzip/parquet adapters; no extension-only interpretation

source_reader.scope: admitted original prefixes only; exclude derived
source_reader.kms: kms:Decrypt only if actual source encryption requires it, exact key and service/context restriction

derived_writer.implementation: worker application role combines source_reader and derived_writer scoped policies; no separate credentials handled by reducer

allow: SubmitJob exact reducer jobdef revision and approved queue
analysis_dispatcher.pass_role: exact reducer application/execution roles, service-bound as required; registration/build by deployment identity only

allow: read derived receipts, catalog index pages, query page files
bounded original manifest/key export read if explicitly requested

execution_role.scope: ECR digest-pinned image pull and log stream only; reuse existing role only after exact policy/resource verification

deployer.purpose: one-time approved IAM/template/image registration by authorized Devin deployment identity; not Edison credential relay

readback.query: structured filter AST/column allowlist, not arbitrary shell or unconstrained SQL; Parquet projection and partition/row-group pruning on AWS; JSONL/Parquet bounded export files
readback.pagination: never silent truncate; returned/scanned/remaining-known counts, complete bool, reason, next continuation bound to frozen catalog/query hash and next stable row key, explicit final null; one oversized row gets ROW_TOO_LARGE with selectable columns not omission
readback.query_scan_ceiling: applies to source partitions scanned as well as tiny return size; no pretending selected columns reduce JSONL source scan cost
readback.joint_example_rule: Join metrics to runs many-to-one; multiple metric roles/IDs must pivot via explicit uniqueness-checked key and select named metrics, never duplicate-run cross-product. Population complements from population_intervals or exact native run_scalars, not an invented runs.hull_id/run_key schema.

return_path.proposed_collector_mode: receipt_uri or export_manifest_key with strict allowlist, pins, per-file/total limits; paged list-prefix mode without object bodies
return_path.automatic_trigger: workflow completion notification if integration supports durable callback; otherwise persistent Edison-side bounded GitHub Actions polling with cursor/backoff. Capability must be verified; not assumed
return_path.github: Issue envelope <=32 KiB containing attempt/status/hash/pointers plus bounded summary; full S3 receipt <=256 KiB, paginated child-job receipts if necessary. Artifacts carry requested JSONL/Parquet pages and hash manifest, never raw archives. Publish failure receipt when possible; missing receipt becomes detectable RETURN_PATH_BLOCKED.
return_path.edison: connector discovers receipt, dispatches collect if needed, downloads bounded artifact via authenticated redirect without logging signed URL, verifies artifact and member SHA256, ingests durable project asset/index, acknowledges attempt/query/page IDs. Deduplicate on IDs/hashes; expiry re-collect from immutable S3, no human relay
client_access: Actions read and dispatch write via secure integration
authorized persistent Edison automation/session and artifact download/ingestion capability
return_path.human_role: approve scientific scope/budget and exceptional permissions once as required; not transfer files
return_path.receipt_pagination: Large job-ID/error/partition lists move to pinned pages; receipt retains count, index hash and continuation. A 256 KiB receipt is never pasted wholesale into a GitHub issue/comment.
return_path.qualified_ack: acknowledgments identifies reduction_id via reduction_id field, receipt_id, exact query/pages/hashes, durable project asset IDs, accepted coverage/limits and saved next cursor. No acknowledgment implies scientifically usable completeness.

semantic_rules: Unknown or null budgets, prices, resources, credentials or approval block paid work. max_retries may be zero; other quantitative ceilings must be positive. Budget null is never unlimited.
Bootstrap preflight/inventory and canary require separate bounded admissions before the full-data quote exists.
No source writes/deletes/restores, simulations, fitting, or infrastructure auto-creation.
All operations accept --request FILE --out DIR. plan and validate are strictly offline. status/collect/acknowledge charge API/return budgets.
A query is a bounded AST with explicit table grain, joins, target, metric versions, weights, missingness and frozen catalog; no arbitrary SQL/shell.
No query complete flag without all requested pages or explicit qualified incomplete status.

preflight/inventory/status/collect/acknowledge may use BOOTSTRAP_REQUEST.schema.json for metadata/return only; this admission cannot authorize Batch submission, source payload GET, restore, or materialization. quote and plan remain offline.

Paid REQUEST.schema.json price/quote/resource/admission cross-checks are semantic, including quote expiry, scope equality, shared budget ceilings, exact source/image identity and allowed worker module. Passing structural schema alone never authorizes execution.
reduction_id and parent_reduction_id identify data-reduction executions; attempts.attempt_id is a historical scientific attempt. Engine SHA is never filled from survey or reducer SHA.

All quote inputs, unit prices, scopes, expiry, role/image bindings and measured/estimated uncertainty must be retained in a pinned quote object. The request quote, approval quote_id and scope/price/resource fingerprint must match. Pilot may have a separately admitted conservative bootstrap quote; bulk needs measured pilot results.

Quotes for query/control phases use the same finite admission principles. REQUEST.schema.json is the Batch/paid-operation envelope; BOOTSTRAP_REQUEST.schema.json never authorizes source payload reading.

query query_file is validated by QUERY.schema.json and bound to execution request hash/admission. status/collect/acknowledge use the bounded bootstrap envelope; operation-specific required fields are validated by the shared parser and semantic gate, not inferred from omitted context.

In-envelope admissions are automatic reservations under the preapproved parent scope/budget envelope, never routine per-query/page/resume/phase/campaign PI approvals. Escalate only new scientific scope, budget-envelope exceptions or credential/permission exceptions. This survey authorizes no AWS execution.

STATUS_NAMESPACES.json separates operational lifecycle, source read, capability, metric value, coverage, clinical censoring and historical scientific approval. Exit-code reason labels are not table status literals. Historical stopped attempts are not evidence of missing/lost data; unknown remains unknown absent completion evidence.
